`1` Due to their low frequency, estimating the effects of rare variants is challenging. - 특정 변이 $k$에 대한 개인 $i$의 Genotype을 $G \in \left \{0, 1, 2 \right \}$
MAF 문제 $$y_i = \mathbf{X}_i \boldsymbol{\alpha} + \mathbf{G}_i \boldsymbol{\beta} + \epsilon_i$$ $$\text{MAC}_k \text{ (Minor Allele Count)} = \sum_{i=1}^N G_{ik}$$ $$\text{MAF}_k = \frac{\text{MAC}_k}{2N} = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^N G_{ik}}{2N} \leq 0.01$$ $$\text{SE}(\hat{\beta}_k) = \frac{\sigma_\epsilon}{\sqrt{2N \cdot \text{MAF}_k(1 - \text{MAF}_k)}} \approx \infty$$ $$T_k = \frac{\hat{\beta}_k}{\text{SE}(\hat{\beta}_k)} \to 0$$ `2` To identify associations between rare variants and complex traits, gene-based or region-based tests$^{10,11}$, including the burden test, the sequence kernel association test (SKAT)$^{12}$ and its adaptive optimized version (SKAT-O)$^{13}$, have been commonly used. `3` To address these challenges, we introduce RareEffect, an empirical Bayes approach designed to estimate the effect sizes of individual rare variants while simultaneously estimating gene-level heritability. --- # Step 0. Full model 설정 `1` 포화모형 $$g(\boldsymbol{\mu}) = \mathbf{X}\boldsymbol{\alpha} + \mathbf{G}_j \boldsymbol{\beta}_j + \mathbf{b}, \quad \mathbf{b} \sim \text{MVN}(\mathbf{0}, \, \sigma_g^2 \mathbf{K})$$ # Step 1. Null model fiting `1` $H_0: \beta_j=0$ 상태의 축소 모형을 적합 $$y = \mathbf{X}_i \boldsymbol{\alpha} + b_i + \varepsilon_i$$ $$\mathbf{b} \sim \text{MVN}(\mathbf{0}, \, \sigma_g^2 \mathbf{K}), \quad \boldsymbol{\varepsilon} \sim \text{MVN}(\mathbf{0}, \, \sigma_e^2 \mathbf{I}_n)$$ `2` We used the average information restricted maximum-likelihood algorithm to fit the null GLMM (that is, H0: βj = 0) as in SAIGE step 1. `3` 도출 추정치 - $\hat {\alpha}$: 공변량 계수 - $\hat {\sigma_g}$: Polygenic Variance component `4` 행렬 $\mathbf{K}$: Genentic Relatedenss Matrix, GRM - $\to$ 피험자들끼리 유전적으로 얼마나 닮았는지 나타냄. - $G_{im} \in \{0, 1, 2\}$: $i$번째 개인의 $m$번째 SNP 대립유전자 개수, $G_{im} \sim \text{Binomial}(2, p_m)$ - $p_m$: $m$번째 SNP의 대립유전자 빈도(MAF, Minor Allele Frequency)
행렬 $\mathbf{K}$ 세부 구성 $$\mathbf{K} = \frac{1}{M} \mathbf{Z}\mathbf{Z}^T$$ $$\mathbf{Z} = \begin{bmatrix} \frac{G_{11} - 2p_1}{\sqrt{2p_1(1-p_1)}} & \frac{G_{12} - 2p_2}{\sqrt{2p_2(1-p_2)}} & \cdots & \frac{G_{1M} - 2p_M}{\sqrt{2p_M(1-p_M)}} \\ \frac{G_{21} - 2p_1}{\sqrt{2p_1(1-p_1)}} & \frac{G_{22} - 2p_2}{\sqrt{2p_2(1-p_2)}} & \cdots & \frac{G_{2M} - 2p_M}{\sqrt{2p_M(1-p_M)}} \\ \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ \frac{G_{n1} - 2p_1}{\sqrt{2p_1(1-p_1)}} & \frac{G_{n2} - 2p_2}{\sqrt{2p_2(1-p_2)}} & \cdots & \frac{G_{nM} - 2p_M}{\sqrt{2p_M(1-p_M)}} \end{bmatrix}_{n \times M}$$ $$\begin{bmatrix} b_1 \\ b_2 \\ b_3 \\ \vdots \\ b_n \end{bmatrix} \sim \text{MVN}\left( \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ \vdots \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}, \;\; \sigma_g^2 \begin{bmatrix} K_{11} & K_{12} & K_{13} & \cdots & K_{1n} \\ K_{21} & K_{22} & K_{23} & \cdots & K_{2n} \\ K_{31} & K_{32} & K_{33} & \cdots & K_{3n} \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ K_{n1} & K_{n2} & K_{n3} & \cdots & K_{nn} \end{bmatrix} \right)$$
`5` 그래서 최종 $\hat y$ 산출 $$\hat{y}_i = \hat{\mu}_i = X_i\hat{\boldsymbol{\alpha}} + \hat{b}_i$$ --- # Step 2. Estimation of gene-level heritability ### (1) grouping `1` we divide variants by gene and its functional annotation (LoF, missense and synonymous).
`1` 오픈소스: LOFTEE (Loss-Of-Function Trancript Effect Estimator) - 하버드/MIT 브로드 연구소의 gnomAD 연구팀에서 만듬. (논문 참고문헌 55, Karczewski et al., Nature 2020) `2` 저자들은 저 오픈소스 도구를 이용해서 `UK Biobank 엑솜 데이터`에 직접 적용해 `Group file`을 생성함. --- ## (2) FaST-LMM `1` $n \times k$ 유전형 행렬에 **특이값 분해(SVD)** 를 적용하여, 계산 복잡도를 대폭 줄여주는 method `2` 근데, 위 알고리즘은 단 1개의 분산성분을 추정할 때만 적용 가능함. > As estimating multiple variance components due to distinct functional groups is not feasible with FaST-LMM, we marginally calculate the variance components for each functional group separately... `3` 그래서 위에서 나눈 각 3개 그룹별로, 저 알고리즘을 돌림. - $\tilde{\mathbf{y}}$: Step 1에서 공변량을 보정한 잔차 벡터 - LoF 그룹 추정 $$\tilde{\mathbf{y}} = \mathbf{G}_{\text{LoF}, j}\boldsymbol{\beta}_{\text{LoF}, j} + \boldsymbol{\epsilon} \implies \hat{\tau}_{\text{MLE}, \text{mar}, \text{LoF}, j} \text{ 추정}$$ - Missense 그룹 추정 $$\tilde{\mathbf{y}} = \mathbf{G}_{\text{mis}, j}\boldsymbol{\beta}_{\text{mis}, j} + \boldsymbol{\epsilon} \implies \hat{\tau}_{\text{MLE}, \text{mar}, \text{mis}, j} \text{ 추정}$$ - Synonymous 그룹 추정 $$\tilde{\mathbf{y}} = \mathbf{G}_{\text{syn}, j}\boldsymbol{\beta}_{\text{syn}, j} + \boldsymbol{\epsilon} \implies \hat{\tau}_{\text{MLE}, \text{mar}, \text{syn}, j} \text{ 추정}$$
